Oct 02, 2026 Topic Asset Allocation Equity Investing Investment Principles Market Volatility

In Episode 59 of The Informed Investor podcast: Josh Brown, CEO of Ritholtz Wealth Management, takes a look at where financial advice has been, where it is heading, and what it takes to build a modern advisory business. The discussion, live from the Future Proof Festival, goes further into the forces reshaping wealth management, including AI, integrated technology, custody, direct indexing, and the growing importance of giving advisors more time to focus on clients rather than administrative tasks.   VIEW ALL EPISODES ON YOUTUBE Also available on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.
